title: From bungee to $C^1$ and $C^0$ Hamiltonian systems and their integrability and nonintegrability
summary: We consider natural Hamiltonian systems with potentials that are $C^0$ or $C^1$ on a hypersurface and $C^{\infty}$-smooth in the complement and introduce and study corresponding notions of their integrabilty and non-integrability. As a motivating example, we derive and analyze models of bungee jumping. We provide prototype examples of the Liuoville-Arnol'd theorem for $C^0$ and $C^1$ Hamiltonians.
